integrity: The exact six cyclic tetrahedron generators are reconstructed independently. Every vertex subset of size at most seven is exhaustively checked. All sixty minimum carriers are verified to be induced orientable closed seven-vertex surfaces, and their ambient H2 classes and affine symmetry orbit are computed exactly.
scientific_limitations: The result is mod-two and specific to the standard fifteen-vertex Kühnel--Lassmann three-torus. It classifies minimum vertex supports in H2 but not larger supports or all integral normal classes. The original 1984 source was available only as abstract and metadata through the inspected route.
title: Sixty induced seven-vertex tori are the shortest \(H_2(\mathbf F_2)\)-carriers in the fifteen-vertex three-torus
